race.comment: VOLTRIX (8) has been narrowly beaten in both starts to launch his career, and on each occasion, greenness has cost him the win. He dons the blinkers for the first time, drops in class, and should be too good this time. RENTIER (5) led up and faded as the favourite over 1400m at Hamilton 8 days ago, and dropping back in trip will suit him. He's had a couple of gear changes since then and is worth including. SLUGGER (6) ran on late for fifth on debut and will start from a superior gate this time. Stick with him. CONTARINI (9) resumes from a spell with a couple of jump-outs under her belt, and from a good gate with Damian Lane aboard, she will be among the leading top 4 hopes. CRIMSON STORM (10) makes her debut from the powerful Ciaron Maher stable, and is sure to be well found in the market.
